unit: Miss Agnes Thorne arrived in Brierley as the village's first female schoolteacher, stepping in after the departure of Mr. Pidgeon. She quickly transformed the school atmosphere by introducing creative initiatives, including bi-weekly student recitations, outdoor 'field days' to study nature, daily physical culture exercises, and essay-writing assignments. Recognizing the ambition of her pupils, she formed an advanced after-school group to tutor students preparing for the Regent’s Entrance examination, providing rigorous drills and mentorship. To foster school spirit and raise funds for a new flag, she organized a highly successful Christmas concert in the village hall. Though she received an offer to teach at a grade school in her home district at the end of the year, she declined it out of deep affection for her Brierley students, choosing to stay and guide them through their final year before the Entrance exam.

unit: Brought mistakenly to Grey Shutters by Obed Abernethy instead of the expected orphan boy, Nell quickly wins over Obed and Thirza Abernethy with her loquaciousness and vivid imagination, earning a permanent home. She forms a deep 'bosom friendship' with Isolde Pembroke, naming their playhouse 'Larkrise'. When school resumes, she clashes fiercely with Hugh Carrow after he pulls her braid and calls her 'Carrots', breaking a slate over his head and harboring a long feud against him. She drops out of school temporarily due to an unjust punishment from teacher Mr. Pidgeon, but later returns, competing academically against Hugh. She inadvertently gets Isolde 'drunk' on homemade currant wine by mistaking it for raspberry cordial, causing a temporary rift with Mrs. Pembroke until she saves the life of the Pembrokes' croup-afflicted baby, Posy Fay. Later, when accused of stealing Thirza's amethyst brooch, she invents a dramatic confession about losing it in the lake to escape room confinement and attend a picnic; after Thirza finds the brooch in her own shawl, Nell is forgiven and allowed to attend. Over the next few years, she excels in school, builds close friendships, and studies rigorously for the Regent's College Entrance exams. She eventually places first on the Island on the Entrance examinations, ties with Hugh, and wins the prestigious Avery Scholarship.

When Obed dies suddenly from the shock of losing his life savings in a bank crash, Nell sacrifices her immediate chance to attend college in order to stay with Thirza and teach at Brierley School. She saves the life of young Posy Fay Pembroke during an attack of croup, cementing her reconciliation with Mrs. Pembroke. Later, after graduating from Wexcombe College with High Honors in English and winning the Avery Scholarship, Nell declines a college path to stay at Grey Shutters when Thirza's eyesight fails, taking a teaching post at Brierley School.
